Company Profile

For over a decade, we have been helping global companies transform and implement their IT strategies, optimize processes, and manage vendors. Our flat hierarchies, dynamic team, and open culture enable us to provide tailored solutions for our clients. To strengthen our company's success, we are looking for talented Junior Consultants. 1 Junior Consultant (m/w/d) A Location: Austria (remote), other countries also possible.

Interested in starting your consulting career with us? We look forward to receiving your application.

About the Role:

As a Junior Consultant (m/w/d) A, you will support international consulting projects in project coordination, planning, analysis, documentation and day-to-day project activities. Working closely with experienced consultants and project teams, you will gain practical exposure to project management, transformation and client-facing consulting in an international environment. We are looking for a structured, curious and detail-oriented individual who is eager to learn and develop a career in consulting.

Your Responsibilities:

 * Support project coordination, planning and task management

 * Assist with project management, change management and organisational development activities

 * Support process, stakeholder, risk and time management

 * Prepare and document meetings and workshops

 * Support workshop moderation and follow-up activities

 * Assist with project analysis, effort estimation and OKR tracking

 * Prepare presentations, reports and project documentation

 * Collaborate with international project teams and stakeholders

Your Profile:

 * Good IT knowledge

 * Strong analytical mindset, structured work approach, hands-on attitude

 * Good communication and collaboration skills

 * Fluent in English (all other additional language skills are nice to have)

 * Basic knowledge of project management, project planning and evaluation

 * Basic understanding of change management, organisational development and process management

 * Understanding of meeting and workshop management, moderation and documentation

 * Basic knowledge of OKRs and effort estimation

 * Proficiency in MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Word, MS Project and MS Visio

 * Strong communication, teamwork and problem-solving skills

 * Good command of English and German

 * High attention to detail and a structured, accurate way of working

 * Openness to feedback and willingness to learn

 * Basic presentation and moderation skills

 * Intercultural awareness and ability to work effectively in international teams

What We Offer:

 * The opportunity to develop your career in an international consulting environment

 * Hands-on exposure to diverse projects, clients and industries

 * A supportive environment focused on learning, feedback and continuous development

 * The opportunity to work with international teams and contribute to meaningful transformation projects

Our Benefits:

 * Flat hierarchies and an open, inclusive company culture

 * International team with opportunities to work with global clients

 * Annual company retreats (Barcelona, Paris, Lisbon, Prague, etc.)

 * Flexible working hours with the option to work remotely from anywhere

 * Regular team-building events and company perks/goodies

Remuneration: 50.000,00 EUR Gross

Interested? Send your CV to awesome@aventario.com

DO & CO is one of the world¿s leading premium hospitality and catering companies, employing more than 17,000 people across over 20 countries. Our group includes the renowned brands k. & k. Hofzuckerbäckerei Demel, HENRY and HEDIARD.

DO & CO operates in Austria, Türkiye, Germany, England, Spain, Italy, Poland, South Korea and the United States.

We are searching for a 1 Group Accountant - Consolidation & IFRS Specialist (m/w/x) Location: Wien ,AT

Department: Finance

Contract Type: Full-time

Job Description

YOUR ROLE IN THE WORLD OF DO & CO

As a Group Accountant (m/f/d) with a focus on Consolidation and IFRS, you will be part of our international Group Accounting Team in the heart of Vienna, contributing significantly to accurate and timely group reporting.

Your responsibilities:

 * Contributing to the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS for 93 group entities across 15 countries

 * Acting as the first point of contact for auditors and tax advisors on all group accounting matters

 * Advising group entities on IFRS accounting matters

 * Supporting year-end audits and the overall group consolidation process

 * Actively participating in national and international projects

 * Optimizing and further developing group-wide reporting processes, including automation and digitalization

Qualifications

WHAT SETS YOU APART

 * 4+ years of relevant professional experience in a comparable role within an international environment

 * Excellent knowledge of IFRS; VAT knowledge is an advantage

 * Strong MS Office skills and ERP experience

 * Hands-on mentality, structured working style, and strong communication skills

 * Flexibility and performance-oriented mindset

 * Excellent written and spoken English; German or Turkish are an advantage

Additional Information

YOUR WORK ENVIRONMENT

 * Experience a motivated and dynamic working environment at our international HQ in Vienna's 1st district

 * Be part of a leading ATX-listed company with a global presence

 * Close collaboration with external partners such as auditors and tax advisors

 * Occasional international travel to major events and sporting occasions such as Formula 1, UEFA and FIFA championships, as well as tennis and golf tournaments

 * Individual career opportunities at national and international level

 * Daily complimentary freshly prepared lunch and fruit

OUR ATTRACTIVE OFFER

Starting salary of € 5,500 gross/month on a full-time basis (all-in contract), with willingness to overpay depending on qualifications and individual agreement.

Your place of work is in Vienna's inner city, right next to the Vienna State Opera. A valid work permit for Austria is required.

1 Technical Operator  Plant Operations & Maintenance (m/f/d) to keep our carbonation plant running day to day. Because nobody is closer to the plant than you, you'll also become an important voice when it comes to developing it further.

We're headquartered in Vienna, with two additional technical sites in Vienna and Upper Austria; this position is based at our site in 4800 Attnang-Puchheim. Join an ambitious team and help take CO2 mineralization from pilot to industrial scale.

Key Responsibilities

Plant Operations

¿ Operate the carbonation plant according to operating instructions, including start-up and shutdown

¿ Monitor process parameters (pressure, temperature, CO2 supply, throughput) and respond to deviations following defined procedures

¿ Carry out test series together with our science team

¿ Take material and product samples according to the sampling plan

Material Preparation & Logistics

¿ Receive and store raw materials (industrial mineral residues)

¿ Prepare material as specified (e.g. screening, mixing, moistening, dosing) and feed it into the plant

¿ Move material with pallet truck and crane, optionally also with a forklift

Maintenance & Servicing

¿ Carry out inspections and maintenance according to the maintenance plan

¿ Dismantle and clean the plant and its components

¿ Replace wear parts and fix simple mechanical and electrical faults

¿ Support our engineers and external partners with modifications, extensions and the installation of new components (sensors, wiring, drives)

Documentation & Safety

¿ Keep operating and maintenance logs

¿ Jointly develop work and maintenance plans as well as instructions

¿ Ensure occupational safety, cleanliness and order at the plant and in the warehouse

¿ Bring in improvement ideas from day-to-day operations

Skills & Qualifications

¿ Motivation beats qualifications - if you like to get hands-on, think along and enjoy learning new things, we'll teach you the rest

¿ Completed technical college (HTL, ideally electrical engineering, mechatronics, mechanical or process engineering) or a technical apprenticeship; career changers with good manual skills are welcome too

¿ Experience in electrical work, assembly, installation or operating production plants is a clear advantage - we value commitment and reliability over years on the clock

¿ You can read circuit diagrams and technical drawings and find your way around controls (PLC/HMI) - or want to learn

¿ Careful, reliable and safety-conscious; you're happy to do physical work

¿ Nice to have: welding skills, English, crane licence, forklift licence (optional), qualified electrician certification, experience with bulk materials or pressure vessels

¿ Driving licence B, German skills (B2) and willingness to work occasional overtime

Why Join Us?

¿ Take on real ownership of "your" plant from day one and help shape how it runs and improves

¿ Work closely with a high-performing team of engineers and scientists in a fast-moving startup environment

¿ Variety between plant, workshop and office - no two days are the same

¿ Targeted training, e.g. crane and forklift licences, electrical and control engineering

¿ Grow with us: as we move to industrial scale, your responsibilities grow too

¿ Full-time position (38,5)incl. workwear and personal protective equipment

¿ Fair salary: minimum € 2.173,58 gross per month (paid 14 times a year) under the collective agreement, with overpayment depending on qualifications and experience

¿ Earn a real stake in what you help build, through our employee participation programme
